Maria (CSOps): heads up — noticed the onboarding playbook automation skipped the post-onboard feedback survey for ~120 accounts last night. saw a spike in 'skipped' counts in the runner dashboard. anyone else seeing this?
Jordan (SE): saw anomalies in the metrics. is this CRM webhook -> playbook runner or internal dedupe?
Maria (CSOps): initial triage: looks like events reached the inbox but were filtered by the playbook dedupe layer. grabbing logs now.
Maria (CSOps): ```
2026-03-21T03:12:05Z inbound_event: acct_id=AC-12345 tag=onboard_complete
2026-03-21T03:12:05Z dedupe_check: window=7d matched_prev_event=true action=drop rule=global-dedupe
```
Devon (Ops): right — we rolled a tighter global dedupe last week (7d default) to reduce noise for engagement nudges. i thought onboarding had an exception?
Sam (Playbooks): onboarding should be exempt. our playbook rule has a dedupe:none override, but config might not have applied to the new route. can you paste the rule?
Maria (CSOps): current rule snippet i see on the worker: ```yaml
playbook: onboarding-feedback
triggers:
  - event: onboard_complete
  - filter: properties.plan != "trial"
dedupe_window: 7d  # <-- unexpected, should be 1d or none for onboarding
actions:
  - send_survey: template=onboard-nps
```
Sam (Playbooks): ugh. looks like the migration to the new rule engine lost the per-playbook override and inherited global-dedupe.
Jordan (SE): ok — quick plan: revert dedupe_window to 1d for onboarding-playbook, run a backfill to enqueue missed events, and monitor survey delivery rate. i can run backfill.
Devon (Ops): agree. any risk of re-enqueuing dup messages for older accounts? we should limit to onboarded within last 72h.
Jordan (SE): good call. using this query to find candidates: ```sql
-- find accounts that had onboard_complete but no survey_sent
select a.account_id from events a
left join events b on a.account_id = b.account_id and b.event_type = 'survey_sent'
where a.event_type = 'onboard_complete' and a.ts >= now() - interval '72 hours' and b.account_id is null;
```
PlaybookBot: scheduled dry-run for playbook change on staging at 2026-03-21T10:45:00Z (run_id=run-789) :gear:
Maria (CSOps): owner assignments: Sam -> patch playbook config (dedupe_window: 1d) ; Jordan -> run backfill query & enqueue (limit 72h + dedupe-safe) ; Maria -> monitor NPS delivery & healthscore delta. target: rollback/patch + backfill within 6 hours.
Sam (Playbooks): starting config patch now. i'll push change to staging and confirm dry-run results.
Jordan (SE): prepping backfill script. will post count before enqueue.
Devon (Ops): i'll watch runner throughput and increase worker concurrency if queue spikes.
Maria (CSOps): quick ask — when you enqueue, tag events with metadata {source: 'backfill-2026-03-21', owner: 'Jordan'} so we can filter metrics.
Jordan (SE): will do. snippet for enqueue: ```python
# pseudo
for acct in candidates:
  enqueue('onboard_complete', acct, meta={'source':'backfill-2026-03-21'})
```
Sam (Playbooks): staging dry-run passed, dedupe override applied. no duplicate fires in staging.
PlaybookBot: manual dry-run completed successfully (run_id=run-789) :white_check_mark:
Jordan (SE): backfill results: found 118 candidates. will enqueue in 2 batches to keep load low. posting counts after batch 1.
Jordan (SE): batch1 enqueued 59, batch2 enqueued 59. tagged as requested.
Devon (Ops): saw brief queue spike, autoscale handled it, no errors.
Maria (CSOps): verified delivery: survey API accepted payloads for the first 80 accounts, remaining are processing. early NPS submissions coming in.
Maria (CSOps): summary & next steps: patched playbook to dedupe_window=1d for onboarding, backfilled 118 accounts (72h window), monitoring metrics for 24h. Sam/Jordan/Devon assigned to ops postmortem to understand migration gap. i'll open a short runbook note and add a monitoring alert to detect onboarding-skip-rate > 1% next 7 days. thanks all :pray: 
Sam (Playbooks): noted, will add safeguard test to the CI that verifies per-playbook dedupe overrides persist on deploy.
Jordan (SE): will follow up with a short CSV of enqueued accounts for CS outreach if any fails.
Maria (CSOps): closing loop — as of 2026-03-21T16:00Z, automation delivered surveys for 116/118; 2 failed due to invalid contact emails (created support tickets). closing thread, will drop runbook link in #cs-ops-docs.
